changes: Quote-aware top-level key=value parsing no longer promotes scope-looking text inside quoted or malformed unknown fields.
Uppercase .LOG files use log record boundaries.
Raw Python text does not gain generic key=value authority; AST constant/default records remain authoritative.
Malformed-tail Product/Model/Device can scope a firmware value only when that firmware is recovered from the same malformed tail, preventing retroactive exoneration of an already-explicit conflict.
integrity_notes: Earlier V10 attempts are preserved as failures. One V10.1 attempt also exposed that transform failures were hidden by a shell pipe; the qualification workflow was changed to set pipefail before the successful run.
The successful run applied transform schema von-v10-transform-4 and then froze post-transform hashes before tests/fuzz.
scope: software/parser/retrieval/scripted-selection validation only; not neural accuracy or hidden-grader score
